hint.text:
Für to be gibt es im simple past zwei Formen:
I was
you were
he/she/it was
we were
you were
they were

atoms.b: Zoe ((had)) a great time with her friends last week.
Carson ((did)) his homework an hour ago.
Laura ((went)) for a walk with her dog this morning.
